lines: Strata reads your prompt at 2650 tokens per second.
It lets you run a 125-billion-parameter AI model on your own gaming PC with NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards.
Strata is an open-source app for gaming PC users that runs this AI model locally on your hardware.
Strata reads part of the model from storage, so a smaller card can run larger versions.
Open http://127.0.0.1:8080 in the browser to see a coding agent write the pagoda garden.
It reaches 91% of the full model's SWE-bench Verified score and fits in 32 GB of RAM.
You can also use Strata with French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, or Spanish.
The Qwen team made this open-source app, and it has 16905 GitHub stars.
Git clone this repo or run the installer to set it up.
Save this for anyone wanting a local AI on their own gaming PC.
Run Qwen on your own PC with Strata.
